title: All-basepoint monochromatic random-wave limits from generic constrained hypersurface phase data
difficulty_reason: H2 on its distinct additional core: one cannot obtain a residual monochromatic family by restricting the free-phase perturbations from the polychromatic proof, because the eikonal constraint may obstruct those perturbations. The author parametrizes local unit-gradient phases by smooth hypersurface data with tangential gradient norm below1 and the originalC^T condition. Independent hitting times provide local reachability/hitting maps; collinear sign strata are separated from the noncollinear resonance set, and their kernel-rank estimates control the projected bad-set codimension. The multijet section ofdu then avoids that set becausek(d-1)<kd-1, replacing almost-everywhere by every-basepoint rational independence. This constrained incidence/rank/avoidance construction is independent nonroutineH2 work. The common WKB/local-randomization/Gaussian-limit framework is reused as an input, so its H3 burden is not charged again.
